name: The Cursed Heart
source:
Claimed by the dark and alluring ruler of the Moon Court, will you find a way to escape the world of Fae... or let yourself fall under its spell?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Cursed_Heart,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
被月宫黑暗而诱人的统治者所占领，你会找到逃离Fae世界的方法……还是让自己陷入它的魔咒之中？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Cursed_Heart,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
